enchantments.tooltip: Nearly Finished: This item isn't quite finished, but it's only a step away from completion. Bring it to a Cannith Reforging Station and combine it with melted materials to restore this item to its full potential.

children.tooltip: Quality Intelligence +1: This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +1 Quality bonus to Intelligence.
Quality Wisdom +1: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +1 Quality bonus to Wisdom.
Quality Charisma +1: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +1 Quality bonus to Charisma.

enchantments.tooltip: Lesser Displacement: Equipping this item causes light to distort around you. Attacks from enemies have a 25% chance to miss you due to concealment.
Insightful Potency +32: Passive: +32 Insightful bonus to each Spell Power.
Quality Potency +15: Passive: +15 Quality bonus to each Spell Power.
Mythic Boot Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
